generation_summary.generation_prompt_template: Assigned unique premise + originality preferred + one-line constraint
generation_summary.v3_diversity_policy: Each item receives a distinct assigned theme. Banned topics: therapy, calendars, houseplants, GPS, Wi-Fi, phones, treadmills. Banned structure: X said/told/asked ... so I did. Detected violations are automatically labeled funny=false.
